notes: Original Pokémon art, forest stages, enemies, rules and skills retained. Only two original source files changed; source/public also contains four added font/license files.
additionalChanges: Portrait roster prioritizes the three starter cards and scrolls the selected partner profile.
Full original credits remain accessible from a compact expandable footer.
Portrait HUD, map, upgrade choices, results and touch controls respect safe areas.
QA app access is restricted to localhost:18189 with qa=portrait.
Original local server handlers are compiled into a serialized native dispatcher; saves use WeChat files with backup and atomic replacement.
Runtime assets include forest-used species and Unown 201; all source resources are retained.
Runtime music and cries are converted to 44.1 kHz 56 kbps AAC; original audio is preserved in source.
Laboratory upgrade and item cards use intrinsic-height portrait stacks with separate description and action regions.
Settings tabs wrap within the phone width; settings content and laboratory lists scroll independently.
Native spacing shorthands correctly reset earlier longhand declarations.
Native sliders read HTML min/max/step attributes and clamp decimal values; legacy 0..100 volume settings are repaired to 0..1.
Native startup and screen switches omit unsupported CSS loading panels, wipes and crossfades; starter selection no longer waits for web-only animation timers.
Native UI caches unchanged layout, bounded text measurements and GPU texture storage; visible canvas animations repaint without full relayout.
Native menu rendering is capped at 30 FPS and active gameplay at 60 FPS; scene targets use a 900000-pixel, 1.5x ceiling while UI retains independent resolution.
Portrait sprites redraw only when their animation frame or source image changes.
